request.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Create ONE landscape location-reference PNG, exactly 1536×1024, edge-to-edge, no collage or borders. Recipe: establish — visible location key light; full value range; full detailed drawn environment, with tiny figures only where explicitly requested.

L6 sewer_gate/outside.png. A concrete storm-drain culvert under a Mapo road at NIGHT, seen from the open drainage channel looking slightly up toward the culvert mouth. A small E-grade gate slit stands inside the dark mouth. Establish the drain as ordinary Seoul civil engineering, not a subway construction pit. The broad arched concrete culvert is 4.5 m wide, 3.8 m high; a shallow runnel of water on its flat concrete apron leads into it, with dry narrow banks on both sides. Dark stained concrete wing walls support the road across the TOP of the culvert, a plain galvanized road guardrail about 1.1 m high along the embankment above, a street-light pole at the road edge, dark urban building silhouettes far back. The gate is a slender, irregular VERTICAL TEAR of black-violet #1A1026, about 2.1 m tall and 0.5 m wide, standing on the culvert floor a little inside its mouth. Its edge is a thin cold white-cyan #D8F4FF, much paler than Operator cyan; darkness and a little violet texture inside, no door frame or portal ring. Its pale reflection runs along wet concrete and the shallow runnel. Key light is the ordinary cold-white street lamp above road level, visibly casting a defined pool on the apron; secondary light only from the gate rim. Navy night, wet blue-grey concrete, restrained violet at the gate. No lettering, no symbols, no people, no cars, no hazard tape or construction props. Camera 1.4 m above the concrete channel, modest wide lens, three-quarter view, slight upward angle; one coherent horizon at the culvert spring line, not an aerial view. The road genuinely spans the top of the drain; culvert walls are load-bearing and sit on the apron. Full detailed location key; crisp drawn concrete cracks and inked water reflections, never photographic texture.

Use the attached approved Arc 1 images as the house style and material references, not as a layout to copy. The final attachment is the approved acting-style anchor: match its tapered crisp ink, clean opaque cel shadows, restrained light wash and drawn colour. Do not import any characters, costumes, lettering, props or lighting that the new location scene does not name. All objects belong to one coherent perspective and scale.



No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

A barrel-vaulted red-brown old brick tunnel 4 m HIGH and 5 m wide, arched side tunnels branching from both sides, ankle-deep dark water about 10 cm deep covering the level brick-paved floor. Each adult is about 44 percent of the tunnel's height AT THE SAME DEPTH. Their heads lie close to the common eye-level horizon; farther figure is smaller and feet higher. Water meets only ankles, not knees; a few small inked ripples around feet. Figures remain tiny, architecture owns the frame. Full model-sheet human proportions, no compressed bodies; hide tiny fingers rather than invent hand details.
